Allah swears by the night when it covers.
And by the day when it shines.
And by the One who made boys and girls.
What you work for is not the same.
As for the one who gives and fears Allah.
And believes in the best reward.
We will make the way easy for him.
But as for the one who is stingy and thinks he does not need Allah.
And says no to the best reward.
We will make the way hard for him.
His money will not help him when he falls.
It is up to Us to show the way.
This life and the next life both belong to Us.
So I have warned you of a blazing Fire.
Only the most unhappy person will burn in it.
The one who said no and turned away.
But the one who fears Allah the most will be kept away from it.
The one who gives his money to make himself clean.
Not to pay anyone back for a favor.
But only to please his Lord, the Highest.
And soon he will be happy.
